{{Top}}
{{Quote|Sleep, all life is a dream.|Kit Fisto|<ref name="tcd">''[[The Cestus Deception]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Grievous_dream.png|thumb|right|180px|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] dreams of a time before he became a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]]]]

'''Dreams''' were images, thoughts, and feelings experienced while [[Sleep/Legends|sleeping]]. Force users sometimes had visions of the future during dreams, but the content and purpose of these were often poorly understood.

Dreaming typically took place during a type of sleep known as REM sleep.<ref name="The Last Jedi novel">[[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']]</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|Dreams pass in time.|Obi-Wan Kenobi to Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
[[File:VaderDream-SWArt-Visions.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] dreams of his wife and the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] struggling over him.]]
Two such important Force dreams were [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] nightmares portraying the [[Death/Legends|death]] of his [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|mother]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]],<ref name="AOTC" /> and his wife, [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], [[Death/Legends|dying]] during childbirth. These dreams served as turning points in Skywalker's fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] as they drove him into an obsessive desire to grow powerful enough to prevent those he loved from dying.<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>

As Darth Vader, he had a dream of his now-deceased wife struggling over him with manifestations of the dark side.<ref name="SW:V">''[[Star Wars Art: Visions]]''</ref>

[[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] sometimes dreamed about the past, of the time before he became a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] and [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. In his dreams he would relive old victories and battles from when he was a [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]].<ref name="Dreams of Grievous">"[[The Clone Wars: The Dreams of General Grievous]]"</ref>

Anakin Skywalker remembered that his mother, [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi]], "had many waking dreams, disturbing and strange ... that had scared him a little" as a child on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name=":2">''[[Rogue Planet]]''</ref> The boy Anakin often had dreams himself; while some were more like nightmares, the boy also experienced dreams of being a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].

Anakin's own waking dreams included one in which he envisioned himself somehow trapped in a strange ancient cube that he'd purchased (in his dealings for [[Watto/Legends|Watto]]) from an old [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] on Tatooine.<ref name=":0">''[[Episode I Adventures 5: The Ghostling Children]]''</ref><ref name=":1">''[[Episode I Adventures 6: The Hunt for Anakin Skywalker]]''</ref> The cube's sides had images of what appeared to be two [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] dueling with [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], a [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]], a [[Star map/Legends|starmap]] to a certain [[Moon/Legends|moon]], and a [[Lamp/Legends|lamp]] with a knife-blade through it (a symbol of forbidden knowledge); the remaining sides seemed to have had ancient writing in an unknown language, long since worn away. The cube had no openings, locks or hinges, but Anakin had [[Force sense/Legends|sensed]] something "evil" inside, and that somehow it could open.<ref name=":0" />

In his dream, Anakin found himself inexplicably inside the cube itself, as if it were a huge room from which he could not escape. He banged on its walls and cried for help, to no avail: "Help me get free!" Then he heard a mysterious voice rise from the cube: an "evil voice" inside of it whispered that ''no one could help him,'' that ''he alone must open it''. When the boy asked how, the mysterious voice answered: ''From the inside.'' As he woke from the dream, Anakin heard the same ominous voice still ringing in his ears and was certain that it had not been a dream, for it had been too real: the voice seemed to come from above his bed, from his cubbyhole, where he'd stored the cube. "Did you talk to me?" he asked the cube in the dark. ''Yes. I called to you.'' "Are you trapped in there? ... How can I let you out?" The voice came again: ''From the inside''.<ref name=":1" />

Anakin eventually came to realize that it was ''himself'' who was caught and trapped, that it was ''he'' who had been unable to free himself.<ref name=":1" /><ref name="Episode I Adventures 8: Trouble on Tatooine">''[[Episode I Adventures 8: Trouble on Tatooine]]''</ref> But also that if ever there was to be a liberation, it would have to come somehow "from the inside." But Anakin also realized that this particular cube was "warmer than the night air," and that ''live creatures'' gave off ''heat''.<ref name=":1" />

Only days later, Anakin had another waking dream—once again, an extremely vivid one, but also ''grand'' and "full of hope"—in which "a [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|tall man]] with intense eyes, wearing a poncho" and a lightsaber, had come to take him from Tatooine.<ref name="Episode I Adventures 7: Capture Arawynne">''[[Episode I Adventures 7: Capture Arawynne]]''</ref>

Coincidentally, right before Anakin met [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and party, he had a grandiose dream of a shining white glowing figure (presumably an angel) wielding a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] against a backdrop of space and encircled by shadowy [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] figures fitted for battle, engaged in galactic war; also in this same dream, he saw himself brandishing a blue lightsaber that looked very similar to [[Anakin Skywalker's first lightsaber/Legends|the one]] he would eventually build.<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I Adventures">''[[Star Wars: Episode I Adventures]]''</ref>

Once he'd met Qui-Gon and his companions, Anakin experienced yet another permutation of the same dream, on the night before [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)/Legends|Boonta Eve]]. This time, however, he ''recognized'' the angel: he again envisioned the planetary wars, the armies of droids, "the rumble of transports and tanks, the hum of laser weapons." But at the head of it all, "a mighty queen"—the angel of his recurring dream. This Anakin recognized to be, oddly enough, the same [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|girl]] who accompanied the Jedi to his home.<ref name="Episode I Adventures 14: Podrace to Freedom">''[[Episode I Adventures 14: Podrace to Freedom]]''</ref>

Upon entering the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to begin his path to Knighthood, Anakin continued to have dreams, but they were of an increasingly dark nature. By the [[23 BBY/Legends|time]] Skywalker was 18, the dreams he was vexed with were of a greater intensity than ever before, mainly manifested as disturbing visions of darkness and distorted memories of his time as a slave.<ref name="Star Wars Adventures 1: Hunt the Sun Runner">''[[Star Wars Adventures 1: Hunt the Sun Runner]]''</ref><ref name=":3">''[[Star Wars Adventures 3: The Hostage Princess]]''</ref> He wished he could wipe from his mind his experience as a slave, and he grew increasingly worried about the safety of his mother, Shmi. It had been nine years—and many intervening interstellar [[Star Wars: Jedi Quest|missions]]<ref name=":2" /><ref name="Outbound Flight novel">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref><ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Quest novel series">[[Star Wars: Jedi Quest|''Jedi Quest'']]</ref>—since Anakin had promised her that he would become a Jedi Knight and return to Tatooine to free her, and he remained determined to keep that promise.<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref><ref name="Star Wars Adventures 2: The Cavern of Screaming Skulls">''[[Star Wars Adventures 2: The Cavern of Screaming Skulls]]''</ref><ref name=":3" /> On [[Mission to Fondor (Separatist Crisis)|one of his last]] missions before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] Skywalker experienced one of his most intense dreams yet. He [[Skull Queen's fortress#Disturbing dreams|dreamed]] he was once again back on Tatooine, but this time as a fully grown Jedi apprentice: he encountered the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] he fashioned, [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], and returned to [[Wald's Parts|Watto's junkshop]], where he found his mother abandoned, huddling in weariness and fear in a low cage. His desperate efforts to free her were in vain, and he awoke in a fevered sweat, to hear his own belabored breathing, as if through a [[Breath mask/Legends|respirator]].<ref name=":3" /> Fate would tragically lead the 19-year-old Jedi back to his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] to find Shmi brutally held captive by [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]]. After Shmi died in his arms, young Skywalker suddenly found himself ''in the midst'' of his dark visions as he took revenge on those who had taken his mother's life.<ref name="AOTC" />

[[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]], a [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], would sometimes experience what he recognized as being visionary possibilities in his dreams.<ref name="H2H">''[[Star Wars: Head-to-Head Tag Teams]]''</ref> Shortly after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], Zuckuss had suffered a respiratory attack on the [[Mist Hunter/Legends|''Mist Hunter'']], and had fallen asleep afterward. He dreamed that the mists that shrouded his futures had lifted enough for him to see the possibilities branching out before him.<ref name="OPF">''[[Of Possible Futures: The Tale of Zuckuss and 4-LOM]]''</ref>
